name: LOAD_ALL comma form warns and nulls where the subquery form used to fail

body.query: SET unmapped_fields="LOAD_ALL"; FROM idx1, idx2 | EVAL present = vec IS NOT NULL | KEEP present | SORT present DESC | LIMIT 2
